definitions.gloss: government offices; public agencies; government bodies
definitions.explanation: A collective term for national government agencies and local government offices. Encompasses both central government ministries and local municipal offices.

examples.japanese: {官公庁|かんこうちょう}に{届|とど}け{出|で}を{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To submit a notification to a government office.

examples.japanese: {官公庁|かんこうちょう}は{土日|どにち}は{休|やす}みだ。
examples.english: Government offices are closed on weekends.

examples.japanese: {官公庁|かんこうちょう}の{手続|てつづ}きは{複雑|ふくざつ}で{時間|じかん}がかかることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Procedures at government offices are often complex and time-consuming.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in administrative, legal, and business contexts. {官|かん} refers to national government and {公|こう} refers to local public bodies. Together, {官公庁|かんこうちょう} covers all levels of government.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官公庁|かんこうちょう}の{手続|てつづ}き (government office procedures)
- {官公庁|かんこうちょう}{向|む}け (for government agencies)
- {官公庁|かんこうちょう}に{勤|つと}める (to work at a government office)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {役所|やくしょ}: government office, city hall — more colloquial, usually local
- {省庁|しょうちょう}: ministries and agencies — specifically central government
- {行政|ぎょうせい}{機関|きかん}: administrative body — formal, broader term
